title: Yeosu City Tour Bus 2026: Romantic Bus Double-Decker, Night View and Hyangiram Courses, Prices and Times
description: Yeosu City Tour guide, checked October 2026: the hop-on hop-off double-decker day loop (Odongdo, Yi Sun-sin Square, KRW 5,000), the double-decker night course, the night view course, and the Hyangiram and island-bridge day courses, all from Yeosu Expo Station.
lead: Yeosu's "Romantic Bus" city tours, run by Yeosu City, all leave from Yeosu Expo Station. The double-decker day loop circles Odongdo, Yi Sun-sin Square and Dolsan Park entrance in 35 minutes and you pay as you board; in the evening a double-decker night course and a night view course show the famous Yeosu night sea. Course 1 (Hyangiram) and Course 2 (island bridges) are full-day guided tours.
summary: Yeosu City (run by Dongseo Tour and Boram Express Tour)
All courses leave Yeosu Expo Station
10:30–16:30 hourly, 6 a day · 35 min loop · hop-on hop-off · KRW 5,000
Hyangiram and island bridges · 10:30 · KRW 10,000 each (meals and admission extra)

routes.name: Double-decker day loop
routes.area: Odongdo · Yi Sun-sin Square · Dolsan Park
routes.tip: Pay by cash or card when you board; one ticket covers up to six rides. Closed the first and third Monday of each month. The wristband ticket gives discounts at Aqua Planet, the sea cable car and more.

routes.name: Course 1 (Hyangiram)
routes.tip: The Marine Science Museum (KRW 3,000) is closed on Mondays and skipped that day.

routes.name: Course 2 (island bridges)
routes.tip: Crosses the island bridges between Yeosu and Goheung; the current route started on 1 September 2026.

routes.name: Night view course
stops: Yeosu National Industrial Complex night view
routes.tip: New route from 1 September 2026. The Odongdo fountain runs March–October; when it is off, the tour goes to Hamel Lighthouse instead.

night.duration: 2 h 30 min (50 min at Dolsan Park, 30 min at Soho Dongdong Bridge)
night.text: The double-decker night course stops for 50 minutes at Dolsan Park overlooking Yeosu's night sea, walks Soho Dongdong Bridge for 30 minutes, then passes Hidden Bay and Yi Sun-sin Square to Jongpo Ocean Park (you can get off) and returns around 22:00. It does not run on the first and third Mondays, or on Fridays and Saturdays when the "Busker" bus runs.

tickets.name: Double-decker night course
includes: Dolsan Park and Soho Dongdong Bridge

priceNote: Prices from the Yeosu City tourism site on 29 October 2026. Concessions are for Yeosu residents, students, seniors 65+, veterans, soldiers and disabled people with ID; preschoolers ride free.
howToBook: The double-decker day loop needs no booking: pay by cash or card as you board.
Book the night, night view and day courses online first (Korean site, button below); spare seats are sold on site.
Questions: Dongseo Tour 061-692-0900 (double-decker), Boram Express Tour 061-902-0212 (Courses 1 and 2, night view).
howToRide: All courses leave from Yeosu Expo Station.
The double-decker day loop comes hourly from 10:30 (no 13:30 run) and you can board at any stop.
Evening courses leave at 19:30 (19:00 November–February); arrive 10 minutes early.

faq.q: Where do I board the Yeosu city tour bus?
faq.a: All courses leave from Yeosu Expo Station; the double-decker day loop can also be boarded at Odongdo, Yi Sun-sin Square and its other stops.

faq.q: How much is the Yeosu double-decker bus?
faq.a: The day loop is KRW 5,000 for up to six rides; the night course is KRW 10,000.
Not for the day loop. The night and day courses are booked online first, with spare seats sold on site.

faq.q: Is there a tour to Hyangiram?
faq.a: Yes, Course 1 leaves Yeosu Expo Station at 10:30 and visits Odongdo, Jinnamgwan and Hyangiram, returning at 17:20.
